svg.title: The same argument at panel e gives A′ k = C′Hk((a −e)D). To include every signed and conjugate variant, first apply these finite transformations to the free label, expand each in the same basis, and take the sum of their finitely many coordinate prices. The coefficient lift intertwines these transformations and sends the unit to the actual reference unit, so the resulting bound is for the required physical transformed token. All slots of the word are included before taking the maximum constant. Thus one reporting width works simultaneously for the word; it is not selected after seeing its offsets.
